reason: I already pay for a booking tool and I am not switching calendars. An AI chat box that books into Google or Outlook does not fix the fact that my bookings live in Fresha or Cliniko, and I have no time to wire another tool into my site and train it.
objection: Does it sync with my actual booking software, or do I end up with two calendars and double bookings? And who sets up the code on a website someone else built three years ago?
would_change_my_mind: A written confirmation that it books directly into Fresha, Cliniko and Jobber, plus a setup done for me in under an hour, so I can try the free plan without touching my calendar.
